original_question: For which non-unimodal Hilbert functions H that occur for graded Artinian algebras A can one find a pair (A, ell) with H(A) = H such that the Jordan type and Jordan degree type of A agree with the contiguous Jordan type and contiguous Jordan-degree type determined by H?
target_in_paper: Section 5, Question 5.2, in the subsection on linear Jordan type and contiguous Jordan type. ([uniwersalizm.uken.krakow.pl](https://uniwersalizm.uken.krakow.pl/wp-content/uploads/sites/122/2024/05/Lefschetz-Preparatory-School-Notes-by-Migliore-and-Favacchio-v2-1.pdf))
correct_elements: Your draft already identifies the exact target in the paper: it restricts to non-unimodal Hilbert functions H occurring for graded Artinian algebras, asks for existence of a pair (A, ℓ) with H(A)=H, and seeks agreement between the Jordan-theoretic data of (A, ℓ) and the contiguous Jordan data attached to H. That is essentially Question 5.2. ([uniwersalizm.uken.krakow.pl](https://uniwersalizm.uken.krakow.pl/wp-content/uploads/sites/122/2024/05/Lefschetz-Preparatory-School-Notes-by-Migliore-and-Favacchio-v2-1.pdf))
missing_details: Jordan type and Jordan degree type are invariants of the multiplication map ×ℓ, so in stand-alone form they should be attached to the pair (A, ℓ), not to A by itself; in the graded setting the paper takes ℓ to be a linear form in A1. ([uniwersalizm.uken.krakow.pl](https://uniwersalizm.uken.krakow.pl/wp-content/uploads/sites/122/2024/05/Lefschetz-Preparatory-School-Notes-by-Migliore-and-Favacchio-v2-1.pdf))

The ambient field is arbitrary here: the surrounding Section 5 setup begins with 'Let K be any field,' so Question 5.2 does not impose a characteristic-zero restriction. ([uniwersalizm.uken.krakow.pl](https://uniwersalizm.uken.krakow.pl/wp-content/uploads/sites/122/2024/05/Lefschetz-Preparatory-School-Notes-by-Migliore-and-Favacchio-v2-1.pdf))

The contiguous Jordan type and contiguous Jordan degree type are the combinatorial invariants defined from the bar graph of the Hilbert function H; the paper explicitly points to [30, Definition 2.28] for this. ([uniwersalizm.uken.krakow.pl](https://uniwersalizm.uken.krakow.pl/wp-content/uploads/sites/122/2024/05/Lefschetz-Preparatory-School-Notes-by-Migliore-and-Favacchio-v2-1.pdf))

If the question is to be fully stand-alone, the operator should be stated explicitly as multiplication by a homogeneous degree-1 element ℓ∈A1; since A is Artinian and ℓ lies in the maximal ideal, ×ℓ is nilpotent. ([uniwersalizm.uken.krakow.pl](https://uniwersalizm.uken.krakow.pl/wp-content/uploads/sites/122/2024/05/Lefschetz-Preparatory-School-Notes-by-Migliore-and-Favacchio-v2-1.pdf))

The paper phrases this as an existence problem over Hilbert functions H that actually occur as H(A) for graded Artinian algebras; it does not add extra hypotheses such as Gorenstein, complete-intersection, codimension, or genericity assumptions in Question 5.2. ([uniwersalizm.uken.krakow.pl](https://uniwersalizm.uken.krakow.pl/wp-content/uploads/sites/122/2024/05/Lefschetz-Preparatory-School-Notes-by-Migliore-and-Favacchio-v2-1.pdf))

The paper’s wording is slightly compressed, so a stand-alone rewrite should make explicit that one is asking to realize the contiguous Jordan type Pc(H), and likewise the finer contiguous Jordan degree type Pc,deg(H), by multiplication with a linear form on some graded Artinian algebra having Hilbert function H. ([uniwersalizm.uken.krakow.pl](https://uniwersalizm.uken.krakow.pl/wp-content/uploads/sites/122/2024/05/Lefschetz-Preparatory-School-Notes-by-Migliore-and-Favacchio-v2-1.pdf))
refined_question: Let k be any field, and let H be a non-unimodal Hilbert function that occurs as H(A) for some graded Artinian k-algebra A. For which such H can one find a pair (A, ℓ), where A is a graded Artinian k-algebra with H(A)=H and ℓ∈A1, such that the multiplication map ×ℓ on A has Jordan type Pℓ,A equal to the contiguous Jordan type Pc(H), and similarly, at the finer level, Jordan degree type Pdeg,ℓ,A equal to the contiguous Jordan degree type Pc,deg(H), where Pc(H) and Pc,deg(H) are defined from the bar graph of H? ([uniwersalizm.uken.krakow.pl](https://uniwersalizm.uken.krakow.pl/wp-content/uploads/sites/122/2024/05/Lefschetz-Preparatory-School-Notes-by-Migliore-and-Favacchio-v2-1.pdf))
justification: The draft is already a near-paraphrase of Section 5, Question 5.2. The only paper-faithful sharpening needed is to make the operator ×ℓ:A→A explicit, since Section 5 defines Jordan type and Jordan degree type using multiplication by a chosen linear form ℓ∈A1, and to mention that the contiguous invariants are the bar-graph invariants of H. I have not inserted hypotheses absent from Question 5.2. ([uniwersalizm.uken.krakow.pl](https://uniwersalizm.uken.krakow.pl/wp-content/uploads/sites/122/2024/05/Lefschetz-Preparatory-School-Notes-by-Migliore-and-Favacchio-v2-1.pdf))
